final_elements.name: candy circle

final_elements.name: bow knot

final_elements.name: right ribbon tail

final_elements.name: straight stick

final_elements.name: right sparkle

frames.visible_job: Near the top half of the page, draw one generous hand-drawn circle. Leave open paper below it for the bow and stick.
frames.instruction: Near the top half of the page, draw one generous hand-drawn circle. Leave open paper below it for the bow and stick.

frames.visible_job: Start a loose black spiral near the candy center and wind it outward toward the rim. Stop before crossing the outer circle.

frames.visible_job: Directly under the candy, draw a small oval knot, a rounded loop to each side, and one short pointed ribbon tail beneath each loop. Keep all four parts attached to the knot.

frames.visible_job: From below the bow knot, draw two straight parallel stick edges down and round their lower tip. Stop the top edges behind the bow so no line crosses either loop.

frames.visible_job: Outside the round candy, draw one small four-point sparkle on the left and one on the right. Place three short broken shadow strokes just below the stick tip.

final_step.visible_job: Fill established spiral spaces with bright pink, yellow, teal and orange marker, color the bow purple and stick warm gray.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop shows one confident, slightly irregular round candy outline high on the sheet. Its open interior makes the next spiral easy to place, and the large blank area below reserves room for bow and stick.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: I viewed the full contact sheet and every saved adjacent crop through the colored finish. The same round candy and single spiral persist; the knot attaches both loops and two tails, the stick stays behind the knot, and the two sparkles remain outside. No temporary guides or unexplained missing contours were seen.
